title: Cautious strategy update promotes cooperation in spatial prisoner's dilemma game
motivation: Strategy update may involve costs or risks, yet cautiousness is ubiquitous but ignored in previous evolutionary game studies.
problem_framing: Introduce cautiousness index σ in Fermi update rule on square lattice to control individual learning activity in PDG.
key_insight: Caution creates a threshold that protects cooperators when defector advantage is below σ, allowing clusters to survive and thrive.
method_signature: Fermi update with cautiousness index σ on L=100 square lattice; pair approximation for analytical support.
evaluation_criteria: Cooperator density ρ_C vs σ, temptation b, noise κ; phase transition identification; robustness to initial conditions.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Pair approximation qualitatively agrees but over/underestimates cooperation levels compared to simulation.
thinking_moves: Identify overlooked real-world trait (cautiousness) in existing theory
Formalize intuitive concept as tunable parameter σ in update probability
Trace phase transition points to exact neighborhood configurations
extraction_notes: Year not explicitly stated in paper; DOI suggests 2013. Venue tier estimated as strong based on Physica A impact.
